subject: literacy
concept: Reading a wider set of common irregular sight words, building on the first sight-word set
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading high-frequency word sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student matches an expanded set of physical word cards to spoken words
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the correct sight word among similar-looking distractors
exercise.abstract: Student reads the expanded sight word list aloud with automaticity

misconception_flags: confuses visually similar sight words (was/saw, then/them)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
